quarterly_data.signal: Payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures) were $451.3 million in the year ended June 27, 2026, versus $231.0 million in the year ended June 28, 2025. Purchase obligations - legally binding commitments to purchase inventory and other commitments made to meet operational requirements - were $2.4 billion as of June 27, 2026 ($2,112.5 million due in less than 1 year) and are generally expected to be fulfilled within one year.
quarterly_data.figure: capex $451.3 million (year ended June 27, 2026) vs $231.0 million; purchase obligations $2.4 billion as of June 27, 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Inventory purchases from a single contract manufacturer (Contract Manufacturer A, not named) represented 18.2% of Lumentum's total net inventory purchases for the period ended June 27, 2026, versus 25.1% for the period ended June 28, 2025. Lumentum buys a portion of its inventory from contract manufacturers and vendors located primarily in Thailand, Taiwan and Malaysia; its significant contract manufacturing partners are located primarily in Thailand, Taiwan, Malaysia and the Philippines, and its significant manufacturing facilities are located in the United States, Thailand, China, the United Kingdom, Slovenia and Japan.
